name: The Border March & Forfeit Gap
act: Act II: The Mountain Pass & Ancient Overhang
description: Act II staging ground: The frontier valley surrounding the Customs House plateau, bounded by the eastern mountain pass and ancient 45-degree overhang ruin ramparts in the north.

cast.name: Surveyor Vellum
cast.role: Field Cartographer of the Unwritten Atlas
cast.description: Measures terrain slope and sightlines with a brass theodolite; issues Field Notes (0.40) and Canon Warrants (0.90).

cast.name: Orom the Literal Smith
cast.role: Master of the Grey Wind Forge
cast.description: Answers underdetermined wishes coarsely and literally in quarried stone and iron.

cast.name: Pell the Underwritten
cast.description: Hauling the cleared consignment from the western approach toward the northern scree trail.

primitives.name: Ancient 45° Stepped Bastion (North Rampart)
primitives.stage_role: Non-Navigable Ancient Relic Rampart (≥45° overhang rule)
primitives.description: Cantilevered megalithic stone rampart obeying the 45-degree overhang rule. The ruin has no foundations below the seam.

primitives.name: Theodolite Station & Relic Cairn
primitives.description: Conical dry-stone cairn crowned with a bronze geodetic mounting post holding Surveyor Vellum's calibrated theodolite.

primitives.name: Orom's Literal Wish-Stone Slab
primitives.stage_role: Forged Megalithic Bridge / Literal Wish Artifact
primitives.description: Monolithic quarried granite slab bridging chasm drops, chiseled with coarse runes and answered literally by Orom.

primitives.name: Impounded R6-SHIP Approach Crates
primitives.stage_role: Roadside Freight Stack at Customs Approach
primitives.description: Impounded freight containers stacked alongside the cobblestone road approach.

primitives.name: Frontier Cast-Iron Brazier
primitives.stage_role: Warmth & Night/Cryo Lighting Beacon at Intake Gate
primitives.description: Octagonal cast-iron fire basin resting on tripod legs, burning charcoal embers to warm frontier guards.

primitives.name: Border Milestone Signpost
primitives.stage_role: Wayfinding Marker between Intake Road & Mountain Pass
primitives.description: Weathered oak milestone post with directional arm pointing travellers toward the mountain pass.
